located_point.method: Wikidata starting point kept. The report places the twin mounds about 1.5 km west of the village (Bhan 1975, p. 3); the composite shows the village to the south-east of the starting point and fields, a canal and a bright bare patch near E 613800 N 3196700 to its west, none of which could be identified with the mounds at 10 m.

sources.result: No line measured. The excavated cuttings were 25 x 6 m and 10 x 6 m and backfilled; nothing at 10 m can be tied to the excavated walls.

sources.citation: Suraj Bhan, Excavation at Mitathal (1968) and Other Explorations in the Sutlej-Yamuna Divide. Kurukshetra: Kurukshetra University, 1975.
sources.north_evidence: A line with an elongated loop at its upper end, a short cross-bar and the letter 'N' beside the loop, lower middle of the plan; no true or magnetic wording. The loop-ended needle may follow a magnetic-needle convention; nothing states it.

The only candidate north symbol is a narrow notched arrowhead at the right edge of the fold-out (render pixels about x 3350-3387, y 253-360), without a letter N and partly lost at the page edge; whether its axis is its straight left edge or the bisector of the head is ambiguous by about 8 degrees.
sources.result: Not measured: the plan's north symbol is incomplete and its axis ambiguous, so no line could be referred to north with a defensible error.

line_results.source_locator: Bhan 1975, PDF p. 34 of mitathal1975.pdf (fold-out), Fig. 4 Plan MTL 2; render bhan1975-p34-mtl2-100dpi.png

notes: Imagery: not measurable. Plan: trench MTL-2 on the western mound (Mitathal 2), a 10 x 6 m cutting with Harappan (Period IIA) and Late Harappan (IIB) structures drawn brick by brick. Only Period IIA walls were measured. The walls of Structures 10, 15, 16 and 19 share one direction at theta +16.0 to +17.9 from the plan's north symbol (system mtl2-iia); the walls of Structures 12 (+30.5) and 9 (+3.3) depart from it. The measured faces are 0.7-1.6 m long because the trench is small; brick-by-brick drawing leaves faces irregular at the scale of a brick, which the fit residuals reflect.
plan_search: Held Bhan 1975 report (IGNCA 60032): Plan MTL 1 (PDF p. 32) and Plan MTL 2 (PDF p. 34) are the only plans; sections on PDF p. 22. IAR 1976-77, 2006-07 and 2012-13 mention Mitathal in text only.
stated_orientation_encounters: Bhan 1975, p. 4 (PDF p. 21): trench MTL-1 is described as running 'from south-east to north-west', and Mitathal 2 as having its longer axis north-south; p. 7 (PDF p. 26): 'The streets are 1 to 1.70 meter wide and are laid east-west and north-south.' None was used.
